name: Fellow Opus 2
details: Electric conical burr grinder; dial 0–10 with fine adjustment for espresso.

notes.turkish: Espresso is already at the finest end of the dial.
notes.batch: Fellow's Aiden batch-brew range; Aiden single-serve is 5–7.
notes.immersion: Fellow lists French press and cold brew together (8–10).
notes.coldbrew: Fellow lists French press and cold brew together (8–10).

rangeInfo.note: Fellow Opus 2 Getting Started Guide (hosted by a retailer), grind settings chart: espresso 0–2, Prismo 1–3, AeroPress 3–5, pour-over 5–9, French press/cold brew 8–10; Aiden settings: single-serve 5–7, batch brew 7–10. “For darker roasts, select a higher number within the recommended grind range.”
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: moka pot: from the top of the espresso range to halfway to the top of the AeroPress range (or one AeroPress span finer when there's no espresso range); Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
